runtime.name: FadedCore runtime 0.4.8
runtime.description: Shared FadedCore runtime for Main and Tutorial worlds, Phat Stack all-item stacks, Trafficking/2Faded native content, and the existing Gang Life and Hollywood adapters. Preserves the published 0.4.7 signed-System32 launcher fallback. Updating the framework preserves mod selections and does not install gameplay mods. Restart after updating; back up saves and matching mod state. Connected multiplayer remains unqualified.

sdk.name: FadedCore developer SDK 0.4.1 - World scenes (preview)
sdk.description: Authors only: matching world-scenes kit for runtime suite 0.4.6, including Tutorial-aware verified save sessions, SDK binary/source, templates and helper 0.4.1. SDK assembly/API contracts are retained. Keep inner minimumRuntime 0.4.0 and enforce signed packageDependencies[fadedcore.suite] 0.4.6 via pack --runtime-min 0.4.6. Players do not need the SDK.
sdk.licenseStatus: No first-party license grant is added; owner license selection remains required before a production SDK release.

mods.name: Gang Life
mods.description: Build your own gang or join one of ten fictional factions. Recruit specialists, establish strongholds and contest territory through the tablet headquarters, shared NPC orders, seven firearms, optional third-person, needs and 40 offline voice clips. Install FadedCore 0.4.6 first; every multiplayer peer needs matching runtime/mod packages. F5 headquarters, F4 interaction, F6 camera, F7 map overlay. Early release: connected multiplayer, ordinary firing/reload, native item persistence and audible playback remain unverified.
limitations: Matching FadedCore 0.4.6 and Gang Life 0.2.1 assets are required on every peer. Connected multiplayer has not been observed; support follows the accepted assumed-working/reactive-fix policy.
Ordinary firing/reload, raised grip/muzzle calibration, native item save/reload and audible/positional playback remain unqualified; no manual gameplay gate is imposed.

Four pistol/SMG/rifle definitions use native semiautomatic action; three shotgun definitions use a native pump controller. Automatic fire, a distinct break action and native bat melee are not implemented.
KSG capacity is one effective 14-shell pool without independently selectable tubes.
No measured performance improvement or universal AI arbitration is claimed.

mods.name: Phat Stack
mods.description: Ten native slots split into Equipment 1-5 and Supply 6-0. All ordinary item stacks hold at least 100 carried and 300 per rack slot; higher native limits and item-specific state are preserved. Mutable equipment separates one active unit before use. Requires FadedCore 0.4.8. BACK UP SAVES BEFORE ENABLING: expanded saves require a pre-mod backup to return to vanilla, even after emptying added slots. Restart after updating. Joining-player paths are implemented; connected multiplayer is unverified.
limitations: Enabling changes native inventory saves to an eleven-entry layout including relocated cash. Removal requires a pre-mod save backup; no downgrade exporter exists, even after added slots are emptied.
Restart after changes; live disabling retains structural preservation hooks until game exit.

Joining-player inventory paths are implemented and fixture checked. Actual connected multiplayer, mixed expanded/vanilla layouts and peer negotiation remain unqualified; all peers need matching runtime and mod packages.
Manual drag/drop/split/merge, actual UI oversized swaps, click/V skateboard selection, controller navigation, small/large racks and save-error fault injection remain unverified in gameplay.

All-item limits, mutable-equipment isolation and automatic rack insertion pass native/managed fixtures; this 0.1.3/0.4.8 update has no new live gameplay acceptance run. Item identity, quality, packaging and per-item state still govern merging; currency uses native balance rules.

mods.name: Hollywood
mods.description: 71 gear items across four complete sets, a 24-slot backpack, independent 36-slot duffle, dedicated pistol holster, armor, shields and registered-gas protection. F10 equipment tablet; Z holster; X shield; guarded Space/B shove. Requires FadedCore 0.4.6. Back up saves and matching Hollywood state together; empty bags and return the stored pistol before removal. Host-only equipment; connected multiplayer and remote avatars are unqualified.
limitations: Equipment and storage are host-only. Connected multiplayer, joining clients and remote-avatar equipment are unqualified.

Bag journals are external to the native save transaction. Keep native saves and matching Hollywood state together; ambiguous recovery locks access and retains data. Empty bags and return the stored pistol before disabling or removal.

Production native holster save/process-restart restored the real pistol and seven loaded rounds. Protection, shield shove and controlled third-person firing are covered by the author receipts; physical RMB aiming, original native Jump-down suppression and exact post-LateUpdate rendered bore convergence remain unqualified.
Gas protection applies to explicitly registered inhaled-gas sources, not arbitrary drug/status effects or unrelated direct health writes.
Gang Life and Phat Stack are optional independent mods; their existing save and gameplay limits continue to apply. Restart after package changes.

mods.name: Trafficking / 2Faded
mods.description: Visit the raised 2Faded smoke shop at Westville's Slums Waterfront: 248 storefront entries, 147 native mixing recipes, imported smoking accessories, drug effects and the fictional Compound Z outbreak with preturn Z-Suppressant. Requires FadedCore 0.4.8. Wait for main-menu preparation before loading a save. F11 nearby shop, F4 reusable cannabis accessory, F12 preturn treatment. Back up native saves and matching mod state. Host-local evidence only; connected-client replication is unqualified.
limitations: Host-authoritative content. Connected-client visuals, purchases, outbreak replication and peer traversal remain unqualified.

Wait for the 2Faded main-menu preparation overlay to finish before loading a save. Fully restart after content/runtime updates. Keep native saves and matching mod sidecar state backed up together; safe removal of saves containing custom content is not established.

The frozen mod has protected host-local native purchase, consumption, timed infection, preturn treatment, save/reload and eight-waypoint NPC traversal evidence. The combined 0.4.8 runtime adds the existing mods and all-item inventory fixes; it has build/fixture checks, with no new live gameplay replay.

Physical E interaction, mixing-station ingredient debit, every accessory fit, precise bite/lesion views, every effect expiry, immunity re-exposure and dynamic mixed-product save/reload remain unqualified. F11 is the available shop control.

Imported held props use native consumption animations. Dedicated syringe, pill-swallow, tea-drinking and bespoke bong animations are not supplied. Loaded non-cannabis pipes are excluded from reusable cannabis equipment.
Visible foot contact, player traversal and connected-client traversal remain untested. Compound Z and its recipes are fictional game mechanics.
Runtime works with installer 0.3.20. Installer 0.3.21 adds independent publisher-signed helper updates; compatible framework/mod/helper releases then use this catalog.

The RC6 binaries implement host-authoritative owned NPC replication, map readiness and equipped-avatar presentation. Local RC6 tablet/map/held-model/camera observations are recorded; no connected multiplayer session qualifies these binaries. Every peer needs the matching runtime and authenticated mod assets.
Online badge describes local runtime readiness, not a multiplayer connection.
Ordinary registered-item firing/reload, raised grip/muzzle calibration, native item save/reload, audible playback and remaining teardown/needs/camera boundaries remain unqualified.
Comparative performance remains partial; SDK remains developer preview with no added first-party license grant.
Runtime updates preserve installed mod selections; bundled acceptance examples are disabled and do not activate automatically.
Installer 0.3.20 retains its pinned helper. Use installer 0.3.21 or newer for the automatic menu-badge migration when upgrading runtime 0.4.5; current installer 0.3.23 is recommended.
